WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.time_id,
        s.amount_sold,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_month_name
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
      AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        calendar_month_number,
        SUM(amount_sold) as monthly_total
    FROM france_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_month_number
),
monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        m2020.calendar_month_number,
        m2020.monthly_total as sales_2020,
        m2019.monthly_total as sales_2019,
        m2020.monthly_total * (m2020.monthly_total / NULLIF(m2019.monthly_total, 0)) as projected_2021
    FROM monthly_sales m2020
    JOIN monthly_sales m2019 ON m2020.calendar_month_number = m2019.calendar_month_number
    WHERE m2020.calendar_year = 2020
      AND m2019.calendar_year = 2019
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        projected_2021,
        1.0 as to_us_rate
    FROM monthly_growth
),
monthly_avg_usd AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(projected_2021 * to_us_rate) as avg_monthly_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(avg_monthly_sales_usd) as median_avg_monthly_sales
FROM monthly_avg_usd
